Name: WishingWellPlus
Author: LBBO1
Description:
[b]This mod replaces the vanilla well with a functional well. Players can toss a diamond into the well to wish for a buff, and use the well to fast travel to the mine.[/b]

1. Install SMAPI (if you haven't already).
2. Download and extract this mod.
3. Copy the mod folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.

- Replaces the vanilla well with a new functional well.
- Wish at the well to receive a buff.
- Use the well to fast travel to the mine.

[b]主要用途[/b]
